_about: ACME-POOL: securitisation / direct-assignment pool token (program `loan-pool-nft-program`, standard UNITS-LoanPool). Pool JSON keys are snake_case (except FLDG); money fields are integer STRINGS. Mint links the pool to its ACME-LOAN tokens atomically. NOTE: the seeded LOAN-POOL config uses tokenIdsFrom "payload.loan_token_ids", which code review suggests does not resolve after the engine unwraps the payload (silently skipped -> no LoanPoolMembership claims on the loans). "payload.data.loan_token_ids" is the suggested fix - verify on your instance by reading a member loan after pool mint.

register.name: ACME Loan Pool
register.description: One token per PTC / direct-assignment pool; dependency claims point at every constituent ACME-LOAN token.

schema.description: Documentation only (not enforced). Program requires strings for money fields and the key FLDG (upper case).
